data.content_ref: inline:The adjudication-ritual flag is sustained because the two critics (frontier-claim-honest, frontier-above-floor) are *redundant probes of the same latent quality*. If a frontier claim is truly honest, it should ipso facto be above-floor, and vice versa. The observed pattern—SRC_006/SRC_008 affirming soundness while SRC_007/SRC_009 report failures—reveals not a contradiction but a calibration misalignment: the two critics operationalize the same underlying construct with different stringency levels, so the ritual perpetually flags one or the other. The covering principle is *construct-identity under divergent operationalization*.
